text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing the fierce battles awaiting them in autumn, the Umamusume
strive to improve their skills over the summer...
For that purpose, the summer training camp has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to gain strength, to improve their skills even more...
To grow beyond who they are now, the Umamusume struggle in the dirt, betting everything on this summer. Mejiro Ramonu, too—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, look at her.
She's so gorgeous...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
An actor... or a model, maybe?
Did they come here for a shoot?

text_block_list.name: Passersby A & B
text_block_list.text: Still... so pretty...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...The pattern of the waves.
It's beautiful."

text_block_list.name: Passersby A & B
text_block_list.text:
Even the way you speak is so elegant...
So pretty~.
choice_data_list: (…But she looks even more amazing when she's running—)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"It's more beautiful
when you're running, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Still,
it's so hot!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My, what an unusual guest.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's my line.
I mean, seriously...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you hot
in that outfit?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm just a little curious is all.
If you're fine with it, then it's not a problem.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Always so conscientious, as usual...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I am not hot.
Are you satisfied?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you.
Just one more favor, please!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I want to look you in the eyes
and talk to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That was quite rude of me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And? What is
your business?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just saw you,
so I came over to say hi!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf went over there,
so I ended up with some free time.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Ever since we got here,
I've been hanging out with the folks from the Academy!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: They said this trip is mainly an inspection... to see if there's anything we can improve for the Umamusume during summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And to think she said she was stepping down from the front lines
just half a year ago~.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're totally acting like one of the organizers now.
Just what I'd expect from you, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right, Ramonu, you've been in great shape lately too!
I've been keeping an eye on you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'm honored.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You're going to grow a ton this summer too, aren't you? I'm looking forward to seeing that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Me too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, look, Ramonu!
Those drifting clouds... I wonder where they're heading?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Should I chase them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'll see you off.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Catch you later then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Bound tight, yet wildly untamed.
She is a contradiction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...It is not the clouds
that I am chasing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Doesn't look like we'll have any time to swelter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with a premonition that something was bound to happen...
the summer training camp began!
